description: Scan a set of GLBs for byte-identical embedded images and extract any image shared by ≥ `min_occurrences` GLBs into a shared sidecar directory. Rewrites each input GLB to reference the sidecar via `image.uri`. Returns the per-image and per-GLB savings report. Set `dry_run: true` to plan without writing. Default `min_occurrences` is 2.

dry_run.description: Compute the plan without writing any files.

in_place.description: Overwrite inputs instead of writing to out_dir.

input_paths.description: Sandbox-relative GLB paths to scan for shared images.

min_occurrences.description: Image must appear in this many GLBs to be extracted as shared (default 2).

out_dir.description: Where to write patched GLBs + the shared sidecar dir. Required unless in_place=true.

name: dedup_textures
title: De-duplicate embedded textures across a set of GLBs (SPEC-0091)
